_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
football: The Rainbow Warriors' Mountain West season runs late August to late November at the Ching Athletics Complex on the Manoa campus, six or seven home dates, with the conference championship game and a bowl — the Hawaii Bowl is played at home on Christmas Eve — beyond that.
basketball: The Rainbow Warriors' Big West season runs early November to March at the Stan Sheriff Center, with the Diamond Head Classic over Christmas week and the Big West tournament in Henderson beyond that; the schedule above fills in once the regular season begins.
volleyball: The Rainbow Wahine's Big West season runs late August to late November at the Stan Sheriff Center, the loudest volleyball crowd in the country, with the NCAA tournament in December beyond that.
